source_note: The 15 founder engine names are audited as internal platform lanes, not 15 finished products or 15 separate offers. Only repository evidence is scored.
boundaries: A present file proves only that a repository artifact exists; it does not prove deployment, external validation, customer adoption, revenue, or economic value.
The only primary commercial offer is the buyer-owned baseline validation sprint bound to the canonical strategic transaction packet.
Every engagement requires buyer-authorized data, an accepted baseline, a locked metric and threshold, and a signed paid scope.
Trading and sports lanes remain research and paper-only.
Hardware, identity, energy, and smart-city performance claims remain simulation-bound or conceptual until independent domain validation exists.
Final government certifications, signatures, prices, uploads, submissions, and binding commitments remain human-controlled.

engines.name: Lumen Infrastructure Sentinel
engines.safe_description: Infrastructure baseline, drift, anomaly, and evidence-packet tooling.
engines.buyer_profile: Data-center, utility, hospital IT, telecom, and managed-service operators with an authorized historical or replay dataset.
engines.scoping_use: Test one declared infrastructure claim against an accepted incumbent baseline and return replayable decision evidence.
engines.acceptance_gate: Detect declared injected or historical failure modes at an agreed false-alert rate on buyer-authorized data.
engines.claim_boundary: No outage prevention, realized savings, field validation, safety control, or production deployment claim.

engines.name: LumaTrader
engines.safe_description: Paper-only market research, model comparison, runtime controls, and replayable decision evidence.
engines.buyer_profile: Quant research, fintech research, and model-governance teams.
engines.scoping_use: Compare a frozen paper or replay protocol with a declared baseline after costs and abstention rules.
engines.acceptance_gate: Prospective paper results meet a locked after-cost threshold without breaching risk or reconciliation gates.
engines.claim_boundary: No alpha, profitability, institutional readiness, investment advice, or live-capital claim.

engines.name: Kraken Sentinel / LumaSniper
engines.safe_description: Crypto-market telemetry, guarded signal research, and paper-execution controls.
engines.scoping_use: Review read-only telemetry and paper-ledger controls under a frozen protocol.
engines.acceptance_gate: Prospective after-fee paper results, deterministic kill controls, and complete ledger reconciliation.
engines.claim_boundary: No live trading authority, profit, return, signal service, or investment-advice claim.

engines.name: LumenGov Grant Factory
engines.safe_description: Opportunity qualification, evidence assembly, conformance checks, and human-controlled submission preflight.
engines.buyer_profile: Small businesses, research teams, grant consultants, and government contractors.
engines.scoping_use: Measure preparation latency and conformance defects against the buyer's existing human-controlled workflow.
engines.acceptance_gate: Reduce verified preparation latency or conformance defects while preserving source and approval controls.
engines.claim_boundary: No guaranteed eligibility, submission, award, savings, certification, signature, or portal authority.

engines.name: LumaScout
engines.safe_description: Source-receipted creator discovery shortlists with forward outcome tracking.
engines.buyer_profile: Artist-management, agency, label, and creator-research teams with permitted data.
engines.scoping_use: Compare a pre-registered shortlist with a transparent popularity baseline.
engines.acceptance_gate: Forward outcomes improve on a declared baseline using licensed or permitted data.
engines.claim_boundary: No hit prediction, label adoption, revenue lift, or undocumented data-rights claim.

engines.name: Sports Harmonic Edge
engines.safe_description: Sports-odds ingestion and research scoring under explicit uncertainty and paper-only controls.
engines.buyer_profile: Sports media research and analytics teams with licensed data.
engines.scoping_use: Compare historical and prospective research scoring with simple declared market baselines.
engines.acceptance_gate: Prospective calibration and ranking metrics beat declared baselines without hidden selection.
engines.claim_boundary: No betting advice, guaranteed edge, profit, or consumer wagering automation.

engines.name: CrowdFund Radar
engines.safe_description: Campaign discovery and evidence-linked research queue tooling.
engines.buyer_profile: Product scouts, trend-research teams, and analyst groups.
engines.scoping_use: Compare a pre-registered campaign ranking with a simple popularity baseline.
engines.acceptance_gate: Forward labels show useful lift over the named baseline using permitted sources.
engines.claim_boundary: No investment recommendation, campaign quality guarantee, or return claim.

engines.name: Cyber Forensics Assist
engines.safe_description: Prototype evidence-component scoring and investigation chronology support.
engines.buyer_profile: Incident-response, legal-support, and internal security research teams using approved synthetic cases.
engines.scoping_use: Measure chronology completeness and reviewer agreement without modifying source evidence.
engines.acceptance_gate: A blinded synthetic-case review meets a locked completeness and agreement threshold.
engines.claim_boundary: No forensic conclusion, chain-of-custody certification, legal admissibility, or autonomous response claim.

engines.name: EchoForm Identity Engine
engines.buyer_profile: Future privacy-preserving personal-AI and simulation research partners.
engines.scoping_use: Requirements workshop only after privacy, consent, threat-model, and minimization rules are defined.
engines.acceptance_gate: A consent-first prototype passes deletion, provenance, revocation, and identity-consistency tests.
engines.claim_boundary: No biometric certification, medical inference, identity proof, or continuity-of-person claim.

engines.name: Luma XR Command Room
engines.safe_description: Prototype launch and interface assets for immersive system-state visualization.
engines.buyer_profile: Simulation, training, museum, and enterprise demonstration teams.
engines.scoping_use: Test declared monitoring tasks using non-sensitive sample telemetry.
engines.acceptance_gate: Users complete declared tasks within locked error, latency, and comfort thresholds.
engines.claim_boundary: No operational command authority, training efficacy, comfort, or safety certification claim.

engines.name: Smart City Node Engine
engines.safe_description: Read-only Smart City and telecom edge-system decision-assurance concept.
engines.buyer_profile: Future municipal, utility, and telecom research partners.
engines.scoping_use: Define one authorized telemetry source, accepted incumbent, deterministic simulation or shadow replay, locked metric, and human-owned decision with no actuation.
engines.acceptance_gate: A deterministic simulator beats a named baseline on a locked latency, resilience, or allocation metric.
engines.claim_boundary: No city or network control, commercial-board or 5G replacement, RF/EMC, latency, resilience, privacy, safety, savings, or deployment claim.

engines.name: FlowForm Hardware Engine
engines.safe_description: Simulation, audit, and matched-test planning for curved electronics, honeycomb energy, ground robotics, and versioned digital geometry concepts.
engines.buyer_profile: Aerospace, robotics, EV, and electronics R&D teams with a declared comparator.
engines.scoping_use: Freeze one non-enabling geometry, comparator, metric set, conventional model, safety boundary, and independent bench or manufacturability plan.
engines.acceptance_gate: Pre-registered simulation and independent bench tests beat named baselines on declared measures.
engines.claim_boundary: Concept renders are not CAD or prototypes; no thermal, electromagnetic, battery, robotics, structural, print, manufacturing, safety, certification, or field-performance claim.

engines.name: Energy Harmonization Engine
engines.safe_description: Conventional energy-data evidence, forecasting, calibration, and simulation research component; legacy Nuclear Harmonization material remains a restricted speculative archive.
engines.buyer_profile: Utilities, facility operators, energy researchers, and government laboratories with authorized data.
engines.scoping_use: Run one buyer-authorized forecast replay or evidence-quality assessment on a declared decision.
engines.acceptance_gate: Meet locked accuracy, calibration, timeliness, and economic-conversion rules against a named baseline.
engines.claim_boundary: No nuclear conversion or control, radiation, healing, safety, usable-energy, field-validation, outage-savings, or universal harmonic-superiority claim.

engines.name: World Model Engine
engines.buyer_profile: Enterprise strategy, research, and government analytics teams.
engines.scoping_use: Model one buyer-owned decision using a declared source set, baseline, and uncertainty register.
engines.acceptance_gate: Reproduce declared scenarios and meet a locked decision metric without hidden data or hindsight.
engines.claim_boundary: No complete world model, operational prediction, policy authority, or cross-sector-superiority claim.

engines.name: LumaCore Orchestrator
engines.safe_description: Routing, sequencing, health, and evidence-pack assembly across bounded subsystems.
engines.buyer_profile: Enterprise evidence, workflow, and trustworthy-AI teams after gateway health is restored.
engines.scoping_use: Compare a declared governed workflow with the buyer's existing process while preserving approvals and abstentions.
engines.acceptance_gate: Complete the workflow with fewer verified defects or less preparation time and no approval-boundary breach.
engines.claim_boundary: No autonomous legal, procurement, financial, trading, safety-critical, or production-gateway authority.
